summary: MOOD V2 Phase 2 retention engine + catalog categorization + Phase 1 regression independently verified end-to-end against POST /api/analytics/track. Ran three suites: (1) canonical test_phase2_retention.py — 22/22 pass; (2) Phase 1 regression test_phase1_tracking_v2.py — 14/14 pass; (3) NEW independent suite test_phase2_retention_indep.py written from scratch covering first-ever workout, all four milestones (3/7/14/30), non-milestone day, same-day idempotency, streak_broken after gap, workout_session_completed alias, comeback at exactly 7-day lapse (boundary), 6-day no-comeback (under-threshold boundary), session-start last-active update, all 8 catalog mappings, user_registered=auth, subscription/validate writes only to user_events (legacy analytics_events untouched), and Apple webhook unsigned-payload gate (200 ok:true verified:false, zero subscription_* writes). Backend health 200 healthy. Total: 60/60 backend assertions pass. No retention regressions, no catalog miscategorizations, no legacy-collection writes detected.
critical_code_review_comments: retention.py is clean: dedicated rt_* fields (no clash with UI current_streak), idempotent per UTC day via rt_streak_last_day==today guard, handles delta<=0 (clock skew) by no-op, wraps full process in try/except, never blocks the track call.

Retention emit closure in server.py calls track_user_event(db, current_user_id, ...) which routes retention events into user_events with the correct event_category from EVENT_TYPES — confirmed for streak_extended/streak_milestone_reached/streak_broken/comeback_after_lapse (all category=retention).

user_analytics.py EVENT_TYPES catalog correctly maps all 8 required entries (paywall_cta_tapped, founding_banner_shown, mood_intro_viewed, tip_shown, onboarding_completed, health_permission_granted, notification_opened, share_completed) plus the four retention event types.
Minor: user_analytics.py is ~1378 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Not blocking, but a future split into user_analytics/{core,catalog,admin,drilldowns}.py would improve maintainability.

Minor: in user_analytics.update_daily_activity, only event_type=='workout_completed' increments workouts_completed; workout_session_completed (which retention.py treats as a completion alias) does NOT increment the daily_activity counter. This is an existing inconsistency, not a Phase 2 regression — flagging for awareness only since the dashboard reads current_streak (not rt_*) from the activity-based source.
seed_data_creation: All tests use ephemeral users (prefix p2rt_/indrt_/p1v2*) created via /api/auth/register and fully cleaned up (users + user_events) in test teardown. No persistent seed data added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 retention engine is hooked into POST /api/analytics/track AFTER track_user_event, wrapped in try/except. Streak state lives on user doc fields rt_streak_current / rt_streak_longest / rt_streak_last_day / rt_last_active_day — separate from the UI's activity-based current_streak. To exercise multi-day behavior in tests, pre-seed rt_* fields directly via pymongo using day(-N) helpers (cannot time-travel UTC days against a live server). LAPSE_DAYS=7, MILESTONES=[3,7,14,30]. WORKOUT_COMPLETION_EVENTS={workout_completed, workout_session_completed, featured_workout_completed} all advance the streak. Apple webhook gate is fail-closed because APPLE_APP_APPLE_ID is intentionally unset in this env — returns 200 {ok:true, verified:false} for ANY payload, which is the desired Phase 1 behavior.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues found. All review_request items verified green.
